verdict.rationale: Managed Slurm or Kubernetes is a fair question for a GPU cloud like Vast.ai, but the evidence never mentions either. It documents only raw instance rental, overlay networks for multi-node setups, and a serverless endpoint platform. Those are adjacent building blocks, not a managed job scheduler.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can schedule jobs on managed Slurm or Kubernetes instead of building my own scheduler on raw nodes
